title: 【时间囚笼02】没有痕迹
slug: 回溯凶案现场全警局坐等我破案
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

人体的脖子上，气管、血管和神经遍布。

颈外静脉注射稍有不慎就容易扎错动脉，又或是造成被注射者大出血、甚至是当场直接死亡，导致凶手无法继续接下来的‘仪式’。

除非凶手对人体血管十分地熟悉，并且对自己的扎针技术很有信心，否则ta根本就不可能敢通过颈外静脉注射的方式给死者下药。

“我找到了！”

刘浩强突如其来的一声惊喝，吓得孟长离身体直接一哆嗦，思绪也从方才看到的景象中抽离。

意识到自己咋咋唬唬吓着人，刘浩强讪讪地朝她笑了笑，才开口道：

“这是街道办给开的介绍信和结婚证，还有一份冀城底下的县医院医生开的证明！”

他从行李袋最底层的缝隙夹层里，翻找出几份证明纸。

“来看病的是这家的男人，张涛，今年25岁，冀城人士。因为近段时间长期出现心窝疼和恶心呕吐的症状，医生建议他到大医院去进行更详细的检查。”

“而他媳妇儿张春华则是陪同一起，今年23岁，两人于四年前领证结婚。问题是……床上那俩人连衣裳都没穿，脸也都已经烂得认不出来了，怎么能确认就是他俩啊？”

孟长离自然不能说出自己‘看’到的东西，只能将手中的诊断书和摄片递了过去，暗示道：“张涛患有很严重的胆囊结石，通过尸检应该能确认。”

“这两具尸体的骨龄，倒是都和小刘说的年纪对得上。”张爱梅正忙着将几条体形肥硕的白蛆塞进玻璃瓶里，闻言抬头搭话道：

“而按照小孟说的，那在解剖过后至少能先确认男死者的身份了。目前麻烦的除了身份，主要还是脖子上的针孔。具体被注射了什么药剂和相关剂量，还得送检化验了才能知道，恐怕还有得等。”

孟长离摁住习惯性想要抬起的手，捻了捻指尖。

目前精细毒化只有省厅和公安部的毒化实验室能做，至少也得等一周以上的时间，地方公安局才能拿到化验结果。

即便他们就在京城的公安总局依旧不例外。

这需要的时间太久了……

孟长离开口问道：“张法医，咱们局里面被允许做铜吡啶反应鉴别吗？”

张爱梅眼底掠过一抹讶异：“虽然现在距离死者的死亡时间有点久了，但也应该还是有反应的，就是检测不出具体剂量。不过小孟，你这是学过啊？”

Page (1/3)

The human neck is covered with trachea, blood vessels and nerves.

If the external jugular vein is injected carelessly, it is easy to tie the wrong artery, or it may cause the person being injected to haemorrhage, or even die directly on the spot, making it impossible for the murderer to continue the next 'ritual'.

Unless the murderer is very familiar with human blood vessels and is very confident in his acupuncture skills, it is impossible for him to dare to drug the deceased through external jugular vein injection.

"I found it!"

Liu Haoqiang's sudden shout made Meng Changli tremble in fright, and his thoughts were withdrawn from the scene he just saw.

Realizing that he was bluffing and scaring people, Liu Hao forcefully smiled at her and said:

"This is the letter of introduction and marriage certificate issued by the sub-district office, as well as a certificate issued by a doctor from the county hospital below Jicheng City!"

He rummaged through the slits at the bottom of his duffel bag and found several certificates.

"The man who came to see the doctor is Zhang Tao, 25 years old, from Jicheng. Because he has been suffering from heartache and nausea and vomiting for a long time recently, the doctor recommended that he go to a large hospital for a more detailed examination."

"His wife Zhang Chunhua is accompanying her. She is 23 years old this year. The two got married four years ago. The problem is...the two people on the bed are not even wearing clothes, and their faces are so rotten that they are unrecognizable. How can we confirm that it is them?"

Naturally, Meng Changli couldn't tell what he 'saw', so he could only hand over the medical certificate and the radiograph in his hand, hinting: "Zhang Tao suffers from very serious gallbladder stones, which should be confirmed through an autopsy."

"The bone ages of these two corpses are consistent with what Xiao Liu said." Zhang Aimei was busy stuffing several plump white maggots into a glass bottle. After hearing this, she raised her head and said:

"According to what Xiao Meng said, we can at least confirm the identity of the male deceased after the autopsy. The main trouble now is the needle hole in the neck besides the identity. The specific drugs and related dosages that were injected will have to be sent for testing before we can know. I'm afraid it will have to wait."

Meng Changli held down the hand he habitually wanted to raise and twirled his fingertips.

At present, only the poisoning laboratories of provincial departments and the Ministry of Public Security can perform precise poisoning, and it will take at least a week for the local public security bureau to get the test results.

Even if they are located in the Beijing Public Security Bureau, they are still no exception.

This takes too long...

Meng Changli asked: "Forensic Doctor Zhang, are we allowed to do copper-pyridine reaction identification in our bureau?"

A flash of surprise flashed through Zhang Aimei's eyes: "Although it has been a long time since the death of the deceased, he should still be responding, but the specific dose cannot be detected. But Xiao Meng, have you learned this?"
